Only the projected fixture and the parameter files enter the repository. The fx-chrom artifacts under ../oracle/picked-chromatogram/ were produced by the prebuilt C++ Release build openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 on dax; only the seven cases and the projected oracle TSV enter the repository.

oracle.compile_options: -ffp-contract=off, the PRIVATE option libOpenMS itself is compiled with (cmake/compiler_flags.cmake). Without it the SignalToNoiseEstimatorMedian template instantiated in the driver fuses a*b+c into FMA on arm64 and six noise cases moved by one ulp against libOpenMS's own instantiation (which the picker cases use); measured before the flag was added.
oracle.comparison: bit for bit (IEEE-754 bit patterns), in both the native default and PickingCompatibility::source; the comparison runs wherever the tests run (CI: Linux x86-64), the expected values come from the arm64 Debug build; cases prefixed source_ must be refused by the native default
oracle.build: product SDK, CMake Debug, core 4fdec46 (diff to bc9cc12 empty for these sources)
oracle.estimator_share: 11 cases carry SignalToNoiseEstimatorMedian ratios and percentages directly (the 12 noise cases less extra_noise_manual_invalid), with percentages only 0 or 100; 19 picker cases run the estimator indirectly (signal_to_noise > 0), including 6 chromatogram records (5 in extra_topp2_parameters, 1 in extra_topp2_chromatogram0_check); 62 cases never estimate
oracle.linux_release_rerun: The unchanged driver re-run twice against the Linux x86-64 Release build openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 on ibminode06 printed the same records byte for byte (sha256 9eb8f249...) and the same two parameter files; its standard error differs only by six lines the Debug build alone prints (five mzML loader diagnostics and one 'Update ranges was called but ranges were already up-to-date'). Artifacts: ../oracle/sne-completion/p1/, recorded in tests/data/signal_to_noise_provenance.json.

determinism: The picker and the estimator are serial, as the source is (no OpenMP in PeakPickerHiRes.cpp or SignalToNoiseEstimatorMedian.h); results do not depend on the thread count.
